newsitem.title: USA: Ameristar says Neilsen not to sell stake.
newsitem.headline: Ameristar says Neilsen not to sell stake.

text.p: Ameristar Casinos Inc said Tuesday that president and chief executive officer Craig Neilsen has no present plans to sell his 87 percent stake in the company.
Ameristar said it made the statement in response to rumors that Neilson is seriously ill and that the controlling interest in the company would be put up for sale.

Ameristar said Neilson is under physicians' care, but he has informed the company that his medical advisers do not consider his health problems to be life-threatening and that he has no present intention of selling any of his shares of the company's stock.
Ameristar said Neilsen remains actively involved in the day to day management of the company.
Ameristar said it would have no further comment.
